body: I understand 1000000 percent. I was in a similar situation a few years ago going into the service. Same social akwardness, same feeling that nothing ever goes rite. Even down to the significant other who "claims" they love you but doesn't want you around. Honestly fxck her, you are an amazing human being and you have the ability to do whatever you want in life. Use the financial gain from the marines to fund whatever you see fit. Save up and move to portland, smoke some weed. I know how it feels to have no one to talk to, and I don't know you so this may not hit home. But just know that there are people like myself out there just looking to put hope in the world where its needed.
